messages.text: The shop can’t send the refund to a new card; it can only go to the order’s original payment. A cancelled card doesn’t change that, and the card issuer handles any credit. I can request BRL 150.00 for the cordless screwdriver to the original payment method if you’d like (refund-policy/v2/payment; refund-policy/v2/amount).
